description: This file defines the NotesListViewItemTouchHelper class, which extends ItemTouchHelper to provide swipe-to-delete and favorite-toggle functionality in a RecyclerView displaying notes. It manages swipe gestures, animations, and undo actions, integrating with ViewModel and LiveData for data operations.

classes.name: NotesListViewItemTouchHelper
classes.description: A custom extension of ItemTouchHelper that handles swipe gestures for notes in a RecyclerView, enabling delete and favorite toggle actions with undo support, integrated with ViewModel and LiveData.

methods.name: NotesListViewItemTouchHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ItemTouchHelper with swipe directions and configures swipe actions for delete and favorite toggle, managing UI states and animations.
